channel.title: Animal Futures tournament updates
channel.description: Dated, source-linked updates on participation, forecasts, discussion, and possible uses for decisions.

item.title: October 23: growing coverage, a public forecast citation, and a resolution check
item.description: Original questions average 56 forecasters; September additions average 26. Plant Based Cities cites a sales forecast as a possible benchmark; no changed decision is documented. A Mexico resolution request remains pending. No new official resolutions. Forecast counts, source links, and feedback tooltips are refreshed.

item.title: October 13 update: participation rises; ANIMA measure merits a check
item.description: Counts increased across both waves. The ANIMA benchmark now describes itself as legacy for frontier-model comparisons while retaining open-source training use; organizers may want to confirm it remains measurable and decision-relevant. No new resolutions or public examples of forecast use were found.

item.title: October 3 update: participation rises; question wording corrected
item.description: Forecaster counts on the five September questions rose to 15–23 each. A comment thread caught and corrected inconsistent dates on a cage-free law question. No publicly documented funding or policy use surfaced in sources checked.

item.title: First update: participation, forecasts, and discussion
item.description: Twenty-one questions are listed, including five added on September 20. One cultivated-meat approval question has resolved Yes. This report summarizes participation, current estimates, useful comments, and suggestions for organizers.
